note: P4242 (Pro 24:11) — rescue those being taken to death; hold back those stumbling to slaughter.

dims.v: active mercy — the duty to deliver those going to death
the rescuing/delivering of those being taken to death and stumbling to slaughter — the active obligation to intervene for the perishing, not stand by
(the perishing it is bound to save)
the mercy that will not stand idle while others die

natsal (deliver/rescue) — 'RESCUE those who are being taken away to death'; the wise heart is bound to act for the perishing, not plead ignorance (24:12). To know and do nothing is guilt. Active mercy is a duty, not an option.
